info.title: SmartGN - API Gateway
info.description: Public HTTP entry point for IAM, Installation & Device Management, Support & Maintenance and Payments & Billing. Validates IAM JWTs, applies CORS and request limits, and forwards service contracts without changing their paths. Each owning service verifies current sessions, ownership and delegated functions. Internal routes are excluded. Local HTTP execution does not establish a production TLS or AWS deployment.
